    Representation-finite pieces are representation-directed #

    For a module M over the piece algebra, the total space of repOf M is M, and the push-down action of a path-algebra element on it is the action of its class (totToMod_pdAct). So an endomorphism of repOf M gives one of M (endOfRep), and an indecomposable M gives an indecomposable representation (isIndec_repOf). With representation-finiteness this bounds the length of indecomposables, and with a preprojective component every indecomposable module over a connected representation-finite convex piece is directing (directing_piece).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.totToMod_pdAct {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (M : AR.FDMod k (PieceAlg k S)) (z : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k (pieceQuiver S)) (x : (repOf M).Tot) :
    (totToMod M) (((Rep.pdAct (FinQuiver.Hom.id (pieceQuiver S)) (repOf M)) z) x) = (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun (a b : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k (pieceQuiver S)) => a ∈ relGens k S ∧ b = 0) z • (totToMod M) x
